notes: v0.16.0 upgrades the existing Asympta Computer plugin with an integrated physical-iPad laser loop: bounded status, launch, orientation, captures, xcresult parsing and batched targeted XCTest, per-action latency and deterministic evidence-aware next-step guidance. Incremental Xcode build cache, explicit failure categories and cross-process device lease improve reliability. It does not bypass Apple permissions, synthesize genuine Pencil pressure or assert unexecuted hardware coverage. No new plugin/app installation is needed; see docs/verification/2026-10-09-native-ipad-laser-bridge.md.
